verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator documents a bulk QR-code transfer from an old device to a new one (docs-3, docs-11), and users confirm it can export all codes into a QR code. However, that export is described as being for re-import into Google Authenticator on another device (comm-18), and a user reports it is 'stupendously difficult to just get a simple text export to a file' (comm-6). Missing for 10: an open or human-readable export format (e.g. text/otpauth URIs), documented migration to third-party apps, and an encrypted file backup under user control.
